cases.question: Leg uit waarom de Industriële Revolutie in Groot-Brittannië kon ontstaan.
cases.baseline_answer: De Industriële Revolutie in het 18e-eeuwse Groot-Brittannië werd gekenmerkt door een ongekende versnelling van technologische innovatie. De verbeteringen van James Watt aan de stoommachine maakten het mogelijk om fabrieken los te koppelen van waterbronnen. De textielindustrie groeide door uitvindingen zoals de spinning jenny. Dat leidde tot urbanisatie en fabrieksarbeid.

cases.question: Explain why the Industrial Revolution could emerge in Great Britain.
cases.baseline_answer: The Industrial Revolution in eighteenth-century Great Britain was marked by an unprecedented acceleration of technological innovation. James Watt's improvements to the steam engine allowed factories to operate away from water sources. The textile industry expanded through inventions such as the spinning jenny. This led to urbanisation and factory labour.

cases.question: What should I pay attention to when putting a classification model into production?
cases.baseline_answer: Make sure the model is trained on representative data and evaluate it on a separate test set using metrics such as accuracy, precision and recall. Put it behind an API, log predictions, and version both the model and the data so results can be reproduced.
points_to_integrate: Audit bias and fairness across protected groups.
Check for label leakage between training and test data.
